messages.subject: Which VNC template should I use if I want to show the FANC neuron on that.
messages.subject_clean: Which VNC template should I use if I want to show the FANC neuron on that.
messages.body_plain:
Dear Dr. Jefferis and everyone,

I am using natverse and trying to plot the neurons from FANC dataset. I have difficulty to visualize the neurons in the VNC template.

The codes I am using:
T1_right=read_fanc_meshes("648518346486670233")
plot3d(JRCVNC2018F,alpha=0.1) or plot3d(VNCIS1,alpha=0.1)
wire3d(T1_right$`648518346486670233`, col='Green', lwd=1)
shade3d(T1_right$`648518346486670233`, col='Green', lwd=1)

I can show the neuron and VNC template separately in the 3D view, so I guess how they cannot be viewed in the same window is because I used the wrong template for that. So, if I would like to view my neuron in the VNC template, should template should I use in the plotting?

Bests
Li

messages.subject: Re: Which VNC template should I use if I want to show the FANC neuron on that.
messages.subject_clean: Which VNC template should I use if I want to show the FANC neuron on that.
messages.body_plain:
Hey Li,
thanks for your question and for using natverse. In the latest update of the fancr package, we added a simplified FANC surface mesh.
So if you just update it like this: devtools::install_github("flyconnectome/fancr")

You should see your neuron on the mesh:

library(nat)
library(fancr)
T1_right=read_fanc_meshes("648518346486670233")
wire3d(FANC.surf, col='grey')
plot3d(T1_right, col='green', lwd=2)

Best wishes,
Dominik
